cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS store_count FROM analytics.dim_store AS s JOIN analytics.dim_region AS r ON r.region_id = s.region_id WHERE r.city = 'Surabaya' AND s.is_open = TRUE
assumptions: “Has” means stores currently open; closed stores are excluded.
cases.answer: The company has 5 stores in Surabaya.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_product_count FROM analytics.dim_product AS p JOIN analytics.dim_category AS subcategory ON subcategory.category_id = p.category_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS department ON department.category_id = subcategory.parent_category_id WHERE p.is_active = TRUE AND department.level = 1 AND department.category_name_id = 'Elektronik'
assumptions: Elektronik refers to the level-1 department, including its subcategories.
cases.answer: Ada 38 produk aktif di kategori Elektronik.

cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.payment_method FROM analytics.fact_payments AS p JOIN analytics.fact_orders AS o ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' ORDER BY p.payment_method
assumptions: Treat a payment method on a non-cancelled order as used; include pending COD and refunded payments, but exclude cancelled orders.
cases.answer: Customers have used bank transfer, card, cash, cash on delivery (COD), e-wallet, and QRIS.

cases.sql: SELECT opened_date FROM analytics.dim_store WHERE store_name ILIKE '%Gading Serpong%'
assumptions: Matched the store by the phrase “Gading Serpong” in its store name.
cases.answer: The Gading Serpong store opened on February 14, 2025.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM analytics.fact_orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'
assumptions: “In total” means all cancelled orders in the available orders data, with no date restriction.
cases.answer: A total of 2,079 orders have been cancelled.

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(fs.shipping_fee_idr) AS total_ongkos_kirim_idr FROM analytics.fact_shipments AS fs WHERE CAST((fs.shipped_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((fs.shipped_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
assumptions: Mengartikan tahun 2025 sebagai tahun kalender dalam WIB, berdasarkan tanggal pengiriman (shipped_at).
cases.answer: Total ongkos kirim untuk paket yang dikirim selama tahun 2025 adalah Rp163.292.500.

cases.sql: SELECT ticket_category, ROUND(CAST(AVG(csat_score) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_csat_score FROM analytics.fact_support_tickets WHERE ticket_status = 'resolved' GROUP BY ticket_category ORDER BY ticket_category
assumptions: Tickets without a CSAT score are excluded from the average, as AVG ignores NULL values.
cases.answer: Rata-rata CSAT tiket dukungan yang terselesaikan: account 4,01; delivery 3,44; other 4,03; payment 4,07; product_quality 4,00; dan refund 3,47.

cases.sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS registered_customer_count FROM analytics.dim_customer GROUP BY segment ORDER BY segment
assumptions: Registered customers are the rows in analytics.dim_customer.
cases.answer: There are 5,034 registered members, 14,014 regular customers, and 952 VIP customers.

cases.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity), 0) AS returned_units FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r JOIN analytics.fact_orders AS o ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE r.reason = 'damaged' AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
assumptions: “Arrived damaged” corresponds to return reason = 'damaged'.
Count returned units across the available data window, excluding cancelled orders.
cases.answer: 1,950 units.

cases.sql: SELECT p.brand, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.brand LIMIT 5
assumptions: Interpreted “in 2025” as calendar year 2025 in WIB.
Ranked brands by total quantity sold; ties at fifth place are limited to five rows, with brand name as a deterministic tie-breaker.
cases.answer: The top 5 brands by units sold in 2025, excluding cancelled orders, were Rasa Nusa (7,073), Melati (5,349), Sekar (5,114), Rupa (5,039), and Sari Buah (4,543).

cases.sql: SELECT s.store_name, SUM(t.visitors) AS total_visitors FROM analytics.fact_store_daily_traffic AS t JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = t.store_id WHERE t.traffic_date >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND t.traffic_date < CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.store_name ORDER BY total_visitors DESC LIMIT 1
assumptions: Jumlah pengunjung adalah total footfall harian toko selama Agustus 2026; jika ada seri, query menampilkan satu toko teratas.
cases.answer: Arunika Jakarta Senayan memiliki jumlah pengunjung terbanyak pada bulan Agustus 2026, yaitu 1.482 pengunjung.

cases.sql: WITH late_po_counts AS (SELECT s.supplier_name, COUNT(*) AS late_purchase_order_count FROM analytics.fact_purchase_orders AS po JOIN analytics.dim_supplier AS s ON s.supplier_id = po.supplier_id WHERE po.received_date > po.expected_date GROUP BY s.supplier_name), ranked AS (SELECT supplier_name, late_purchase_order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY late_purchase_order_count DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM late_po_counts) SELECT supplier_name, late_purchase_order_count FROM ranked WHERE supplier_rank = 1
assumptions: A purchase order counts as late when it was received and received_date is later than expected_date; suppliers tied for the highest count are all returned.
cases.answer: PD Halim (08) has the most late purchase orders, with 182.

cases.sql: SELECT s.courier, COUNT(*) AS parcels_delivered FROM analytics.fact_shipments AS s WHERE s.shipment_status = 'delivered' AND CAST((s.delivered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((s.delivered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.courier ORDER BY s.courier
assumptions: Count each shipment row as one parcel, using the WIB delivery date (delivered_at).
cases.answer: In September 2026, AnterAja delivered 124 parcels, GoSend 113, JNE 338, J&T Express 314, and SiCepat 221.

cases.sql: SELECT s.traffic_source, ROUND(CAST(AVG(CAST(s.converted AS INT)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS conversion_rate FROM analytics.fact_web_sessions AS s JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = s.channel_id WHERE c.channel_code IN ('website', 'app') AND CAST((s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.traffic_source
cases.answer: For website and app sessions in 2025, conversion rates by traffic source were: affiliate 7.78%, direct 8.40%, email 8.33%, organic search 8.67%, paid search 8.41%, push notification 8.45%, and social 8.16%.

cases.sql: WITH returned_units AS (SELECT parent.category_name AS main_category, SUM(r.quantity) AS returned_units FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r JOIN analytics.fact_orders AS o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS subcategory ON subcategory.category_id = p.category_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS parent ON parent.category_id = subcategory.parent_category_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((r.returned_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((r.returned_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND parent.level = 1 GROUP BY parent.category_name), ranked AS (SELECT main_category, returned_units, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY returned_units DESC) AS category_rank FROM returned_units) SELECT main_category, returned_units FROM ranked WHERE category_rank = 1
assumptions: “Selama 2025” berarti tanggal retur (WIB) jatuh pada tahun kalender 2025.
Jika beberapa kategori utama sama-sama memiliki unit retur terbanyak, tampilkan semuanya.
cases.answer: Kategori utama level 1 dengan unit retur terbanyak selama 2025 adalah Fashion, sebanyak 609 unit.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) WHERE d.date_key = CAST('2025-11-11' AS DATE) AND d.is_harbolnas = TRUE
assumptions: Count all orders placed on that date, including orders later cancelled; the question asks for orders placed, not fulfilled orders or revenue.
cases.answer: 183 orders were placed on Harbolnas, 11 November 2025.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) AS business_date, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE)), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r JOIN order_net AS n ON n.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id
assumptions: “Last month” means September 2026, based on the provided date of 2026-10-01. Revenue is attributed to the order’s WIB date, with refunds subtracted as specified by the metric definition.
cases.answer: Our net revenue last month was IDR 6,648,011,300.

cases.sql: WITH ramadan_days AS (SELECT date_key FROM analytics.dim_date WHERE year = 2025 AND is_ramadan = TRUE), daily_orders AS (SELECT d.date_key, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM ramadan_days AS d LEFT JOIN analytics.fact_orders AS o ON CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) = d.date_key GROUP BY d.date_key) SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(order_count) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_orders_per_day FROM daily_orders
assumptions: Menghitung semua pesanan yang tercatat, termasuk yang dibatalkan.
Menghitung setiap tanggal Ramadan 2025, termasuk tanggal tanpa pesanan.
cases.answer: Rata-rata jumlah pesanan per hari selama Ramadan 2025 adalah 82,10 pesanan.

cases.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN d.is_weekend THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END AS day_type, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) WHERE d.date_key >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND d.date_key < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY d.is_weekend ORDER BY d.is_weekend
assumptions: Count all orders placed in the period, including orders later cancelled; order counts are not subject to the revenue exclusion rule.
cases.answer: In calendar Q2 2026, 1,996 orders were placed on weekends and 4,009 on weekdays.

cases.sql: WITH monthly_orders AS (SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1) SELECT month_start, completed_orders FROM monthly_orders ORDER BY completed_orders DESC, month_start LIMIT 1
assumptions: “2025” means calendar year 2025; months are based on WIB order dates.
The busiest month is the month with the most completed orders.
cases.answer: There were 2,367 completed orders in the busiest month of 2025, March.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) AS order_date, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE)), refunds AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns GROUP BY order_id) SELECT SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id WHERE n.order_date >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND n.order_date < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)
assumptions: Kuartal fiskal pertama FY2026 berarti 1 April hingga 30 Juni 2026; refund dikaitkan dengan tanggal pesanan.
cases.answer: Pendapatan bersih pada kuartal fiskal pertama FY2026 adalah Rp19.910.055.317.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(o.total_amount) AS DECIMAL) / COUNT(*)) AS aov_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
assumptions: “2025” means calendar year 2025 in WIB, not fiscal year FY2025.
Average order value includes orders that were not cancelled, after line discounts and before refunds.
cases.answer: The average order value in 2025 was IDR 3,562,194.

cases.sql: WITH fashion_items AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.quantity FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS subcat ON subcat.category_id = p.category_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS department ON department.category_id = subcat.parent_category_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND department.category_name = 'Fashion'), returned_units AS (SELECT r.order_item_id, SUM(r.quantity) AS quantity_returned FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r JOIN fashion_items AS fi ON fi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id GROUP BY r.order_item_id) SELECT ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(SUM(ru.quantity_returned), 0) AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(SUM(fi.quantity), 0), 4) AS return_rate FROM fashion_items AS fi LEFT JOIN returned_units AS ru ON ru.order_item_id = fi.order_item_id
assumptions: “Fashion” means the top-level department; its products are identified through their level-2 subcategories.
“Sepanjang 2025” means calendar year 2025 using WIB order dates.
cases.answer: Return rate kategori Fashion untuk pesanan sepanjang 2025 adalah 0,0488 (4,88%).

cases.sql: WITH as_of AS (SELECT MAX(CAST((ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE)) AS d FROM analytics.fact_orders) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS active_customers FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o CROSS JOIN as_of WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) > as_of.d - 90 AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) <= as_of.d
assumptions: “As of the end of the data” uses the glossary default as-of date: the last order date in the data, converted to WIB.
cases.answer: As of the end of the data, we have 3,021 active customers.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(CAST(s.converted AS INT)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS conversion_rate FROM analytics.fact_web_sessions AS s JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = s.channel_id WHERE c.channel_code = 'website' AND CAST((s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE)
assumptions: September 2026 refers to sessions whose start date falls in September in WIB.
cases.answer: The conversion rate of website sessions in September 2026 was 8.26%.

cases.sql: WITH order_values AS (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr) AS gross_sales_idr, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id), refunds AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount_idr) AS refunded_idr FROM analytics.fact_returns GROUP BY order_id) SELECT SUM(v.gross_sales_idr) AS gross_sales_idr, SUM(v.line_net_idr - COALESCE(r.refunded_idr, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_values AS v LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = v.order_id
assumptions: FY2025 means 1 April 2025 through 31 March 2026, inclusive, using WIB order dates.
cases.answer: FY2025 gross sales were IDR 79,493,869,800, and net revenue was IDR 74,011,993,834.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.channel_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, o.channel_id), refunds AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns GROUP BY order_id) SELECT c.channel_name, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = n.channel_id LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id GROUP BY c.channel_name ORDER BY c.channel_name
assumptions: Omzet ditafsirkan sebagai net revenue: nilai setelah diskon dikurangi refund, tidak termasuk pesanan yang dibatalkan.
Tahun 2025 menggunakan tanggal kalender WIB; channel ditampilkan dengan nama kanal.
cases.answer: Omzet bersih per channel pada 2025: Marketplace Rp8.807.719.750; Mobile app Rp13.659.072.333; Physical store Rp40.634.336.525; dan Website Rp9.711.151.516.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id), refunds AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns GROUP BY order_id) SELECT n.customer_id, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id GROUP BY n.customer_id ORDER BY net_revenue_idr DESC LIMIT 10
assumptions: Interpreted “best customers” as the top 10 registered customers by net revenue over the available order history; net revenue excludes cancelled orders and subtracts refunds.
Customer names are not available in the analytics views, so customers are identified by customer_id.
cases.answer: By net revenue, our best customer is ID 330 (IDR 2,526,776,533), followed by ID 12244 (IDR 1,646,859,550) and ID 198 (IDR 1,578,851,800).

assumptions: “Bulan ini” berarti Oktober 2026, berdasarkan tanggal hari ini yang diberikan.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.store_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.order_id, o.store_id), refunds AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns GROUP BY order_id) SELECT SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = n.store_id JOIN analytics.dim_region AS reg ON reg.region_id = s.region_id LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id WHERE reg.city = 'Jakarta'
assumptions: “Sales” means net revenue: line sales after discounts minus refunds, excluding cancelled orders.
Use all available order dates (2024-01-01 through 2026-09-30); attribute orders to the city of their fulfilling store.
cases.answer: Sales in Jakarta are IDR 44,637,964,758.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, r.city, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) AS order_date, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id JOIN analytics.dim_region AS r ON r.region_id = s.region_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, r.city, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE)), refunds AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns GROUP BY order_id) SELECT n.city, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id GROUP BY n.city ORDER BY n.city
assumptions: September 2026 refers to WIB business dates; city is the order's store city. Row-level security restricts results to regions the user may see.
cases.answer: Net revenue in September 2026 was: Bekasi IDR 511,632,600; Bogor IDR 467,519,200; Depok IDR 317,587,100; Jakarta IDR 1,447,211,300; and Tangerang IDR 611,888,600.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS jumlah_pesanan FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id JOIN analytics.dim_region AS r ON r.region_id = s.region_id WHERE r.city = 'Surabaya' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE)
assumptions: “Bulan lalu” berarti September 2026, berdasarkan tanggal yang diberikan (2026-10-01).
Jumlah pesanan menghitung pesanan yang tidak dibatalkan; pesanan online dihitung berdasarkan toko pemenuhnya di Surabaya.
cases.answer: Jumlah pesanan toko-toko di Surabaya bulan lalu adalah 0.

cases.sql: SELECT s.store_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name ORDER BY order_count DESC, s.store_name LIMIT 3
assumptions: Counts all orders placed in calendar year 2025 WIB, including cancelled orders; the revenue rule excluding cancellations does not define order counts.
“Across all regions” means all rows available under the existing row-level security.
cases.answer: The 3 stores with the most orders in 2025 across all regions were Arunika Jakarta Senayan (866 orders), Arunika Bogor Cibinong (648), and Arunika Tangerang BSD (645).
